notes.title: Chapter II Release + Сompetition
notes.notes:
The day has come! A year and a half, we made chapter 2 in several people on our own! 
And we thank you believed in us! 
Contest! Everyone who leaves reviews to chapter 2 - write to our public t.me/iktp_ru 
And we will accidentally choose players and give $ 50. 


We also have a special prize for the one who will be the first to play and open all achievements .
This is a handmade diorama made on the scale of the hero’s apartment.

notes.title: ORI THE CAT - UPDATE ≽^•⩊•^≼
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44893348/76177bfacc7c81652d0bd90e45c205d8d74578dd.png

Thanks to our VIP subscribers, Georgy and Evgeny, our old friend, the cat Ori, has been updated and improved.

Yes, he is now back in the chat, and you can chat with him on the topics of the I Know This Place plot or on any topics.

The cat responds to "Ori" or to replies to his messages.

Also thanks to everyone who wrote about the voice acting. We chose people. Their voices will be in Chapter 2. But there will also be contests. We are an interactive project after all!

And don't forget to support the project:
